Done: the line no longer says who added the person. It says what the role is for, starting 'As an Org Owner you…'. One line per role lives in _wire/world.ts (roleBriefs), so every role's card follows the same pattern. Org Owner: 'As an Org Owner you lead the district on Endless Access: you choose who runs it with you, and you can do everything an Org Manager does.'
